acceptanceCriteria: Profile the slowest cli tests; the package completes within 30 m at load ~50 or is sharded/parallelized with evidence.
TestCALV0197 deadline failure reproduced or cleared under load.
body: Found by lane V1-1550 (PR beamfall/corvint#1019) on 2026-10-17. Whole-package `go test -count=1 -timeout 30m ./internal/tasks/cli` ran 387 PASS / 0 FAIL then hit the 30 m package timeout at host load 43-57. Sibling of V1-1499 (internal/tasks/store). Also TestCALV0197_RunRoleSelectsAnsweredWaitOfItsStage failed with context deadline exceeded under the same load (not rerun).
title: tests: internal/tasks/cli package exceeds the 30m package timeout under load 43-57
